actions.create-contact.description: Creates a new contact in a GetResponse campaign.
Select the campaign list to use.
actions.create-contact.props.email.descr: The email address of the contact to create.
actions.create-contact.props.name.descri: The contact name as it should appear in GetResponse.
actions.create-newsletter.description: Creates a newsletter and queues it to send to the selected campaign.
actions.create-newsletter.props.campaign: Select the campaign list to use.
actions.create-newsletter.props.fromFiel: Select the verified sender address to use.
actions.create-newsletter.props.htmlCont: The newsletter content in HTML format.
actions.create-newsletter.props.name.des: An internal name for the newsletter inside GetResponse. Leave empty to use the subject.
actions.create-newsletter.props.plainCon: The plain text version of the newsletter content.
actions.create-newsletter.props.replyToF: Select the verified sender address to use.
The subject line for the newsletter.
actions.create-or-update-contact.descrip: Creates a contact or updates the existing contact with the same email in the selected campaign.
actions.create-or-update-contact.props.c: Select the campaign list to use.
actions.create-or-update-contact.props.e: The email address used to find or create the contact.
actions.create-or-update-contact.props.n: The contact name as it should appear in GetResponse.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find-campaign-list.props.limit.d: The maximum number of campaign lists to return.
actions.find-campaign-list.props.name.de: Enter part or all of the campaign list name. Leave empty to return the first lists in the account.
actions.find-contact.description: Finds a contact by email address.
actions.find-contact.props.campaignId.de: Select the campaign list to use.
actions.find-contact.props.email.descrip: The email address of the contact to find.
